Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.action

Record Class Command

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.bsc.langgraph4j.action.Command
Record Components:
gotoNode - containing the name of the next node to execute.
update - A Map containing key-value pairs representing updates to be merged into the current agent state. An empty map indicates no state updates.
public record Command(String gotoNode, Map<String,Object> update) extends Record
Represents the outcome of a CommandAction within a LangGraph4j graph. A Command encapsulates instructions for the graph's next step, including a target node to transition to and a map of updates to be applied to the AgentState.

    • withMergedUpdate

      public Command withMergedUpdate(Map<String,Object> newUpdate, BinaryOperator<Object> mergeFunction)
      Returns a new Command whose update map is the merge of the current update map and the provided newUpdate map, using a custom mergeFunction to resolve conflicts when both maps contain a value for the same key.

      When a key exists in both the current update and newUpdate, the mergeFunction is called with the two conflicting values (current value first, new value second) to produce the value that will appear in the resulting map. Keys present in only one map are included as-is.

      The resulting Command preserves the same gotoNode as this instance.

      Example — keep the longer string on collision: 

      
 Command merged = command.withMergedUpdate(
     Map.of("key", "newValue"),
     (existing, incoming) -> existing.toString().length() >= incoming.toString().length()
                             ? existing : incoming
 );
      Parameters:
      newUpdate - the map of state updates to merge into the current update map;
      mergeFunction - a BinaryOperator invoked when the same key is present in both maps; the first argument is the value from the current update, the second argument is the value from newUpdate; must not be null
      Returns:
      a new Command with the merged update map and the same target node
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if mergeFunction is null
      See Also:
      • withMergedUpdate(Map)
